up: Find compounds (molecules) where the activity data originates from the publication with the identifier CHEMBL5727821. sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, md.pref_name, a.molecule_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727821' AND a.activity_id IS NOT NULL;
